display_name: Obstructive/Mixed Apnea-Hypopnea Index (NREM): (Obstructive apneas with no oxygen desaturation threshold used and with or without arousal +mixed apneas with no oxygen desaturation threshold used and with or without arousal + hypopneas with > 30% flow reduction and with >= 3% oxygen desaturation or with arousal) / hour of NREM sleep from type I polysomnography
description: Calculated - Apnea hypopnea index (3% desats) in NREM sleep
calculation: 60*(oanbp + oanop + manrbp + manrop + hnrba3 + hnroa3)/(slptimem - minremp)
